post_recovery_matching.honest_correction: An earlier claim of 13/13 matched cues was computed across the WHOLE TS, so a cue could match a PRE-recovery occurrence of the same looping passage. Restricted to the proven post-recovery interval (>=282.2s) the result is 5 of 13 cues matched. That is the correct figure. It still demonstrates post-recovery text in the outgoing stream, but it does NOT establish one-to-one correspondence for every preserved cue.
post_recovery_matching.what_this_proves: Caption TEXT is present in the outgoing stream after recovery (5 matched cues within the interval), so the acceptance-path property 'text reaches the output after recovery' holds.
post_recovery_matching.what_this_does_NOT_prove: Full one-to-one cue correspondence for the preserved post-recovery VTT; timing alignment is approximate and the program loops, so only interval-restricted matches count.
